readonly_mode: Read-only: file changes are disabled on this site (DISALLOW_FILE_MODS).
search_content_hint: Also search inside text and code files
drop_here: Drop files or folders to upload
editor_empty: Choose a file on the left to edit it.
empty_hint: Drag files here or use Upload.
search_partial: Showing the first results only. Search in a smaller folder for more.
locked_hint: Protected: cannot be moved, renamed or deleted
sensitive_hint: Contains secrets: never shared with AI
archive_hint: The ZIP file is created in this folder.
cut_n: %s items cut. Open a folder and paste.
cut_n_1: Cut. Open a folder and paste.
copied_n: %s items copied. Open a folder and paste.
copied_n_1: Copied. Open a folder and paste.
trash_hint: You can restore it from the trash.
some_failed: Some items could not be processed
conflict_msg: %s items already exist in the target folder. Replace them? The replaced files go to the trash.
extract_msg: "%s" will be extracted into a new folder next to it.
shared_msg: Visitors can browse and download this folder where you add the shortcode below (copied). Add it to any page or post.
perm_public_write: Write access for everyone is not allowed.
perm_hint: Usual values: 644 for files, 755 for folders.
versions_hint: Each save keeps the previous content. The last %s versions of a file are kept.
restore_version_msg: The file goes back to this version. The current content is kept as a new version.
upload_conflict: "%s" already exists. Replace it? The old file is kept as a version.
trash_days: Items are deleted for good after %s days.
trash_forever: Items stay until you empty the trash.
empty_trash_msg: Everything in the trash will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
set_hidden_d: Files starting with a dot, such as .htaccess.
set_trash_d: 0 keeps items until you empty the trash.
set_quota_d: Your hosting plan disk space, e.g. 100. Usage is measured for the whole hosting account. 0 shows usage only.
set_versions_d: Earlier contents kept on every save (text files up to 3 MB). 0 turns it off.
set_ai_d: Flux AI chat can list, read and search files, and asks you before every change. wp-config.php, .env and key files are never shared.
set_mcp: External MCP clients may change files
set_mcp_d: Off: Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients can only read. On: they can write, move and delete (to the trash).
set_code_d: Lets AI change .php, .js, .css, .html, .htaccess and similar files. WordPress core and protected files stay off-limits.
set_risky: This lets AI change more of the site. Every change is still logged in Activity and earlier versions are kept. Continue?
set_shared_d: Folders in uploads that visitors can browse with the [flx_files] shortcode. Right-click a folder › Share on site.
unsaved_msg: "%s" has unsaved changes. Close it anyway?
sensitive_banner: This file holds passwords or keys. It is never sent to AI; be careful when sharing it.
core_banner: WordPress core file: changes are lost when WordPress updates.
not_writable_banner: The server does not allow writing this file; it is opened read-only.
core_save: This is a WordPress core file. A mistake can break the site and the change is lost on the next WordPress update. Save anyway? The previous content is kept as a version.
sensitive_save: This file controls the site configuration. A mistake can take the site down. Save anyway? The previous content is kept as a version.
ai_edit_ph: e.g. Add a comment above each function / Fix the syntax error on line 12
ai_edit_hint: AI suggests a change and shows the difference. Nothing is saved until you apply it and press Save.
ai_applied: Applied in the editor. Review it and press Save.
